ahmedakrei: The sergeant gave Bastian Ahmedakrei a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 14 or any other. After what happened at Blackwater Canal, Bastian Ahmedakrei asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued.

Bastian Ahmedakrei borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian Ahmedakrei. Bastian Ahmedakrei read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A parcel from home held a comb. Bastian Ahmedakrei has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. Bastian Ahmedakrei read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.
Bastian Ahmedakrei spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. The corporal called out the mail. Bastian Ahmedakrei heard the name and almost ran.
Bastian reinforced a dugout roof with logs and sandbags. It will not stop a big shell, but it will stop the dust.
alex_sunley: Henrik "Brick" Sunley unpacked a rosary of rough beads at Q-F15. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Henrik "Brick" Sunley was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Henrik "Brick" Sunley did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Dorian Itzwill, badly wounded. Henrik "Brick" Sunley cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Henrik "Brick" Sunley fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Otto Taylocirapto was grazed.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit of the Concord and Henrik "Brick" Sunley of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
Henrik "Brick" Sunley got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Henrik "Brick" Sunley was hit hard in the fight at Q-F15 before anyone could fire. The raider was Leopold "Tin" Jake of the Concord. Raider: Leopold "Tin" Jake of the Concord (@jake_81590).

A bullet went through Henrik "Brick" Sunley's upper arm at Q-F15 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Silas Nthuff of the Concord (@nthuff66). Henrik "Brick" Sunley looked over the parapet at Q-F15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Silas Nthuff of the Concord (@nthuff66).
Emil Sunley arrived carrying the family name of Henrik "Brick" Sunley. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Emil and Ulrich Felix stood watch together and traded jokes in whispers. The jokes were old, but the whispers were new.
bardo.bryce: Arno Bryce arrived on Day 16 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Arno Bryce polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Arno remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. The letter for Arno had only one line: 'Come home soon.' Arno read it more times than a one-line letter should be read.
charlie.deakins: Matthias "Shadow" Deakins came from Belmonte, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Matthias "Shadow" Deakins wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Matthias "Shadow" Deakins woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained. The clerk counted the names twice. Matthias "Shadow" Deakins is number 837 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-R8. Matthias "Shadow" Deakins has learned to walk bent double.

In the rear quarters, Matthias "Shadow" Deakins played football against the sappers. The ball was a sandbag stuffed with straw. The sappers cheated. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias "Shadow" Deakins. Matthias "Shadow" Deakins read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Matthias "Shadow" Deakins did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Matthias "Shadow" Deakins fired back. Pavel Zdsh was grazed.
Bram Kochek and Matthias "Shadow" Deakins sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Matthias "Shadow" Deakins found a chair in the barn and sat down carefully, as if it might be reserved for someone of higher rank.
Matthias "Shadow" Deakins raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-R8. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Dietrich Wolfmananton of the Hegemony (@wolfmanantony).
Matthias "Shadow" Deakins came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Bram Wolfmananton, badly wounded. Matthias cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
coreyxpainter: At the depot, Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte had practised answering to his name. At R-C13, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte helped stack spare sandbags at R-C13. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home found Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte before the night shift. Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte folded it small and kept it close.

Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte and Ivo "Tin" Chappell have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte is number 680. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

A bullet hit Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-C13. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Pavel Reider of the Hegemony (@reider9921). Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte was killed at R-C13 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Pavel Reider of the Hegemony (@reider9921).
Yann Coreyxpainte took the same post at R-C13 where Henrik "Brick" Coreyxpainte stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich kept Yann Coreyxpainte awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Rabbit could have walked there blind.

A round came through the loophole Yann Coreyxpainte was watching at R-C13 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Jakub "Shadow" Barrett of the Hegemony (@james.barrett09). Yann Coreyxpainte was killed at R-C13 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Jakub "Shadow" Barrett of the Hegemony (@james.barrett09).
Dorian "Owl" Coreyxpainte had heard about Yann Coreyxpainte's courage. At R-C13, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Dorian "Owl" Coreyxpainte did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Dorian "Owl" Coreyxpainte fired back. Matthias "Shadow" Slush was badly wounded.
Dorian "Owl" Coreyxpainte tried to describe the smell of Belmonte and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
Dorian and Bram Chappell cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
danhammer40000: On the way to T-S6, Konrad Danhammer tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Konrad Danhammer stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Konrad Danhammer was hit hard at the Ossuary Wood. Two men carried him down the communication trench on a door torn from a ruin. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In T-S6, Konrad Danhammer listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Konrad Danhammer lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
The medics called Konrad Danhammer 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Konrad Danhammer is back on the line.
Roland Rachelejosia cut Konrad Danhammer's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Konrad Danhammer. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Konrad Danhammer measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
The sergeant at T-S6 called out a range and a spot. Konrad Danhammer was the only one who hit it. Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins was badly wounded.
Konrad fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Oskar "Hollow" Cnfilip was grazed. Konrad ate breakfast without a word.
eh_its_lesyk: Roland Lesyk arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a cracked shaving mirror and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F5. Roland Lesyk has learned to walk bent double.

The water jacket hissed as Roland Lesyk fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Florian Jacoorb was badly wounded. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Roland Lesyk stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Roland Lesyk saw Dietrich Muzio freeze up on the fire step at Hill 304. Roland said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Roland Lesyk wrote a letter for Dietrich Samhatespeac's mother, because Dietrich could not find the words. Dietrich signed it.
Matthias "Owl" Femgoobert and Roland Lesyk carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Roland Lesyk in the open at Q-F5. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Florian Fitness of the Hegemony (@lewis_fitness99). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Roland Lesyk fell at Q-F5 and never moved again. Shot by Florian Fitness of the Hegemony (@lewis_fitness99).
The papers connected Felix Lesyk to Roland Lesyk. The men took longer to learn Felix Lesyk's own habits, but they made the effort.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Zeno Jimhotrod stood up to sing louder, and Felix Lesyk fired. Zeno Jimhotrod was badly wounded. The singing stopped.
Felix Lesyk counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
Felix reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-F5 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Felix "Hollow" Stnmz of the Hegemony (@thomas.stnmz).
golfer4deer: Day 9. The corporal put Gideon "Rabbit" Deer beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into T-F5. Gideon "Rabbit" Deer has learned to walk bent double.

Gideon "Rabbit" Deer and Wendel Scottkurom split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. After the loss of Grey Mill, Gideon "Rabbit" Deer helped stack spare sandbags at T-F5. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Gideon "Rabbit" Deer and Silas Monsta tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Gideon "Rabbit" Deer counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
Gideon "Rabbit" Deer began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Gideon "Rabbit" Deer pulled Isidor "Button" Etpepsic out of a flooded shell hole at Saint-Ash crossroads. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Gideon "Rabbit" Deer gave Silas Monsta the last match in the trench. Silas used it to light a candle so that Rabbit could finish a letter.
Gideon "Rabbit" Deer saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at T-F5 and fired once. Viktor Haber was badly wounded.
A splinter of duckboard, kicked up by a shell, went into Gideon's calf. The medic pulled it out with pliers. Gideon did not make a sound.
h_dawg_1898: By the time Matthias "Bones" Dawg reached R-S4, the war was 8 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Matthias "Bones" Dawg drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below Calvary Farm the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Matthias "Bones" Dawg watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Matthias "Bones" Dawg and Clement "Rabbit" Dian spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Matthias "Bones" Dawg is number 524. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Matthias "Bones" Dawg helped stack spare sandbags at R-S4. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A bullet went into Matthias "Bones" Dawg's chest just under the heart at R-S4. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Gideon Bao of the Hegemony (@d4rth_bao). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Matthias "Bones" Dawg was carried in at last. Matthias "Bones" Dawg recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through.
Matthias "Bones" Dawg lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Matthias "Bones" Dawg spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to R-S4.
Matthias "Bones" Dawg kept watch so that Nils Antonioo could sleep. Then Nils kept watch so that Bones could. Neither slept.
Matthias "Bones" Dawg was hit in the foot through his boot at R-S4. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Otto Baumann of the Hegemony (@tegan_baumann).

The wound looked small. It was not. Matthias "Bones" Dawg was carried back with a fever and a hand that would not stop shaking. A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Matthias "Bones" Dawg. Nobody pretends that is not how it works.
The worst is over for Matthias. He asked for a cigarette and the nurse said no. He asked again and she said maybe tomorrow.
honey_.engel: Day 9. The corporal put Karel Engel beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Karel Engel had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Konrad Nsrr crossed it, Karel Engel fired. Konrad Nsrr was grazed. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Karel Engel could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home found Karel Engel before the night shift. Karel Engel folded it small and kept it close.

Officers came to inspect R-C15. Karel Engel polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is. The clerk counted the names twice. Karel Engel is number 921 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-C15 changed before the cheering ended. Karel Engel shouldered another load.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Karel Engel was faster. Gideon "Shadow" Eight was badly wounded. Karel Engel saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Roland Rachelejosia, grazed.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Karel Engel asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
The parcel for Karel Engel contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Karel Engel had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Florian Marks was grazed.

The flare went up just as Karel Engel reached the Concord parapet. Karel Engel jumped down first. Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak was the man waiting there, and Casimir "Ghost" Mvuisak fell. (@mvuisak) Karel Engel threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Karel "Button" Nikola was down and screaming for a medic. (@zoric_nikola011) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Karel Engel snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Karel Engel free.
Karel Engel's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
A round went through Karel's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Silas Wumpus of the Concord (@flumpus.wumpus).
imposterdonut: Day 9: Viktor Imposterdonu reached R-R2 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Viktor Imposterdonu helped stack spare sandbags at R-R2. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Viktor Imposterdonu of the Concord lost a harmonica in no man's land at the Hanging Bridge. Cyril Rttr of the Hegemony found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Viktor Imposterdonu answered to number 982. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Viktor Imposterdonu looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Viktor Imposterdonu kept watch so that Quentin "Brick" Jules could sleep. Then Brick kept watch so that Viktor could. Neither slept.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Viktor Imposterdonu across the shin at R-R2. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213).
Back on the fire step at R-R2. Viktor Imposterdonu says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Viktor Imposterdonu saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
Viktor Imposterdonu found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Viktor Imposterdonu's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Viktor cleaned the rifle for the third time today. The sergeant said it was already clean. Viktor said it could be cleaner.
its.vergel: After 10 days of war, Q-F19 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Valentin "Spark" Vergel.

A newspaper reached Valentin "Spark" Vergel with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. Valentin "Spark" Vergel walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Valentin "Spark" Vergel was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.

Valentin "Spark" Vergel had just lit a cigarette at Q-F19 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Isidor Mtzrn of the Concord (@david_mtzrn).
The medic looked at Valentin "Spark" Vergel's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to Q-F19. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Valentin "Spark" Vergel tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Valentin "Spark" Vergel measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong.

Valentin "Spark" Vergel's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. Valentin "Spark" Vergel got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck. The new duty roster listed Valentin as a signaller. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Valentin sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Valentin took it personally. The letter for Valentin asked if the food was good. Valentin wrote back that it was. That was a lie, but a kind one.
josiascouper: Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper reported to S-F15 with his brother's pocket watch sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
There is a sniper across the way the men call the Magpie. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Magpie hit all three. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper watched where the shots came from.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.

Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Arno Olie of the Concord (@olie300). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Dawn watch. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Arno Olie, badly wounded.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper waited for that to change. When it did, Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants was grazed.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper was waiting. Bram Archiegregor was gravely wounded.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper was hit hard in the fight at S-F15 before anyone could fire. The raider was Zeno Owenhart of the Concord. Raider: Zeno Owenhart of the Concord (@owenhart247). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper is number 132. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill has been won. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
There was never a bed for Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F15 on his own feet.
Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Arno Olie was gravely wounded.
Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper moved to a new hide at S-F15 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Norbert Bob, gravely wounded.

A bullet found Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper at S-F15, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Arno Ricks of the Concord (@sam.ricks). Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper was killed at S-F15 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Arno Ricks of the Concord (@sam.ricks).
Roland Josiascouper joined S-F15 under the shadow of Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

At S-F15 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Roland Josiascouper turned around and took a shovel blow. Rafael Warhamster of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Rafael Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4).
Roland Josiascouper's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F15 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
A hot piece of metal landed on Roland's back at S-F15. He jumped, yelled, and then laughed out loud.
kangaroo.5791274: Isidor Kangaroo arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in U-F14 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Isidor Kangaroo was hit twice at U-F14, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Bram Jackalaaltos of the Hegemony (@jackalaaltosfritz). Isidor Kangaroo was killed on watch at U-F14. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Bram Jackalaaltos of the Hegemony (@jackalaaltosfritz).

Another member of the House of Kangaroo reached the line: Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo. He asked where Isidor Kangaroo had slept, then chose a different corner. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo before dusk. Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo read it twice and slept a little easier.
Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Benedikt Justmusl crossed it, Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo fired. Benedikt Justmusl was grazed.

Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo before dusk. Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo read it twice and slept a little easier.

During a lull at Verdel Ridge, Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo called across from the Concord line. Marek Elox answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
A note came over the wire at the Chalk Pits, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Bastian Mikesamham.' Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo sang louder.
The sergeant at U-F14 called out a range and a spot. Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo was the only one who hit it. Cyril Drawtoss was badly wounded.
The relief reached U-F14 without Ulrich. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead.
knoturbro27: Hugo Knoturbro arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-R15 with the rations. Hugo Knoturbro ate while listening to the revised orders.

Hugo Knoturbro kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. The clerk counted the names twice. Hugo Knoturbro is number 949 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-R15, Hugo Knoturbro listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Roland Valsteinne stood up to sing louder, and Hugo Knoturbro fired. Roland Valsteinne was badly wounded. The singing stopped.
Hugo Knoturbro put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Edmund Check of the Hegemony and Hugo Knoturbro of the Concord have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Bone Quarry for a week. Both trenches keep score.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Hugo Knoturbro. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Hugo Knoturbro washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
At the Bone Quarry, Hugo Knoturbro of the Concord and Edmund Szymanski of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
Hugo polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
kurkalubos: Florian Kurkalubos joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Florian Kurkalubos wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Florian Kurkalubos had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it. The clerk counted the names twice. Florian Kurkalubos is number 605 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Florian Kurkalubos looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Florian Kurkalubos studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked R-S1 in the dark to learn it by heart.
Florian Kurkalubos censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love.
Florian Kurkalubos agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
Florian Kurkalubos was hit in the hip at R-S1. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Felix Kebapien of the Hegemony (@kebapien22).
Florian Kurkalubos lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Florian Kurkalubos asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Arno "Whistle" Kurkalubos joined R-S1 under the shadow of Florian Kurkalubos's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Arno remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
leighton_hateley: Lucien Hateley arrived at P-F4 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Lucien Hateley could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Two men fed the belt while Lucien Hateley held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Jonas Diegohernand was gravely wounded. Lucien Hateley fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Clement Alexquinn did not get to reply at all, grazed.
Lucien Hateley borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
Lucien Hateley has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes and Lucien Hateley tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.

At P-F4 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Lucien Hateley turned around and took a shovel blow. Arno Man of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Arno Man of the Concord (@ancient_space_man).
Lucien Hateley rejoined the squad at P-F4. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Across from P-F4, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Lucien saw it. Benedikt Daremiamor was grazed.
mothrawhoislesbian: Day 11. The corporal put Wendel Mothrawhoisl beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Wendel Mothrawhoisl watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Wendel Mothrawhoisl stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of N-F14, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
Wendel Mothrawhoisl of the Concord and Felix Dougc of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Chalk Pits. It is getting crowded.
Wendel Mothrawhoisl heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
A parcel from home held a comb. Wendel Mothrawhoisl has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Wendel Mothrawhoisl checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
Wendel Clan (Hegemony) and Wendel Mothrawhoisl (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at Blackwater Canal for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
Wendel was thanked by an officer, which is rare. He wrote it in his notebook so nobody could say it did not happen.
mrsmidgeyt: Nobody asked Leopold Mrsmidgeyt why he came. Nobody in S-S3 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Leopold Mrsmidgeyt of the Hegemony lost a cap on a night patrol near the Chalk Pits. Karel Punchworth of the Concord found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays. A letter from home found Leopold Mrsmidgeyt before the night shift. Leopold Mrsmidgeyt folded it small and kept it close.

Leopold Mrsmidgeyt made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Leopold Mrsmidgeyt crawled the last yards. Leopold Mrsmidgeyt walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home found Leopold Mrsmidgeyt before the night shift. Leopold Mrsmidgeyt folded it small and kept it close.

Leopold Mrsmidgeyt spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. A letter from home found Leopold Mrsmidgeyt before the night shift. Leopold Mrsmidgeyt folded it small and kept it close. Leopold Mrsmidgeyt got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 519. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Leopold Mrsmidgeyt listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Leopold Mrsmidgeyt asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.

The House of Mrsmidgeyt sent another. Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt, uncle of Leopold Mrsmidgeyt, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. The new duty roster listed Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt as a stretcher bearer. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt carried in little Weiss, who lied about his age to enlist. little Weiss kept asking whether his mother would be told. A letter from home found Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt before the night shift. Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt folded it small and kept it close.

A patient apologized for bleeding on Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake. A letter from home found Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt before the night shift. Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt folded it small and kept it close.

Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt taught Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls three words in the language of home. Rabbit uses all three at the wrong moment, every day. A letter from home found Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt before the night shift. Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt folded it small and kept it close.

little Weiss has a fever. Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt sits with him after every shift and reads to him from a book with the last pages missing. A letter for Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt said the whole street was asking about the front. Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt did not know where to begin the answer.

little Weiss was put on the hospital train today, alive. He gave Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt a button from his tunic. Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt wears it on his own. The letter for Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Tobias "Ash" Mrsmidgeyt liked the crossed-out parts best.
Tobias checked every man in the section for lice. It took two hours. The squad called it the most thorough inspection of the war.
mulletoperator: They issued Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a tin whistle in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first. After what happened at Sorrow Copse, Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat asked to serve as a chaplain. Nobody argued.

Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat opened his eyes today and asked for water. At S-R8 they cheered when the news came up the line. The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home reached Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat before dusk. Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat read it twice and slept a little easier.

Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat spent the day in bed trading cigarettes for stories with the man in the next bed. He came out ahead. A letter from home reached Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat before dusk. Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
The papers say Matthias "Saint" Mulletoperat. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Lucien "Owl" Mulletoperat's eyes. Nobody in S-R8 argues.
Matthias "Saint" Mulletoperat had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Karel Ritualforsam crossed it, Matthias "Saint" Mulletoperat fired. Karel Ritualforsam was grazed.

The gun at S-R8 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas, grazed. A burst of machine-gun fire caught Matthias "Saint" Mulletoperat in the open at S-R8. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato of the Concord (@cavocato). Matthias "Saint" Mulletoperat was killed at S-R8 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato of the Concord (@cavocato).
A letter came with Ivo Mulletoperat: "I am Matthias "Saint" Mulletoperat's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Brass cases piled up around Ivo Mulletoperat's boots at S-R8. Out of all those rounds, one found Emil "Brick" Xavidonegan, grazed.

A loose thread in Ivo Mulletoperat's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain. The letter for Ivo Mulletoperat was mostly about the weather at home. Ivo Mulletoperat read that part twice too.
Ivo Mulletoperat fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Isidor Betts did not get to reply at all, grazed.

Ivo had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Clement "Doc" Nightrunner was badly wounded. The letter for Ivo was addressed to the wrong trench and had been to two others first. It was slightly muddy and entirely welcome.
paper_mercenary: Ulrich Mercenary came up the line with a lucky button and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich Mercenary stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Ulrich Mercenary said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Ulrich Mercenary watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Ulrich Mercenary fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Zeno Thebaconnati and Ulrich Mercenary made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Benedikt Coketez snores. Ulrich Mercenary does not. Ulrich now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
Ulrich Mercenary raised his head for a heartbeat too long at T-F20. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Hugo Boi of the Hegemony (@m4sk3dn3k0boi).
Three days with a bandage, and Ulrich Mercenary is back at T-F20. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Ulrich Mercenary's hands still remember being a printer's apprentice's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Two flares went up over the Brickworks. Ulrich counted the seconds between them and the sound. It was a habit by now.
peter_moodster__moodie: After 2 days of war, S-F19 had a place for everything. On Day 3, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Leopold Moodie.

Leopold Moodie and Bram Tephydraws argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. Now serving as a rifleman, Leopold Moodie discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Leopold Moodie of the Concord and Otto Elitecelebs of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near the Chalk Pits all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold Moodie went out with the wiring party at S-F19. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Leopold Moodie looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Leopold Moodie fixed the strap on Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold Moodie began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Officers came to inspect S-F19. Leopold Moodie polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold Moodie wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Leopold Moodie was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F19. Leopold Moodie has learned to walk bent double. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold Moodie is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Leopold Moodie is number 236. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Leopold Moodie transferred to the stretcher bearers. The men in S-F19 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-F19 with the rations. Leopold Moodie ate while listening to the revised orders.

A patient at the aid post asked Leopold Moodie for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The barrage caught Leopold Moodie in the open at S-F19. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Leopold Moodie was carried in at last. Leopold Moodie recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Leopold Moodie died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
Cyril Moodie put a child's drawing of a horse beside the bunk. Someone who had known Leopold Moodie helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Cyril Moodie checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Moodie. Cyril Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Ulrich Catshannon stood up to sing louder, and Cyril Moodie fired. Ulrich Catshannon was badly wounded. The singing stopped. A sniper's bullet hit Cyril Moodie at S-F19. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Anselm "Ash" Gossett of the Hegemony (@zach_gossett). Cyril Moodie was hit at S-F19 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Anselm "Ash" Gossett of the Hegemony (@zach_gossett).
Another member of the House of Moodie reached the line: Oskar Moodie. He asked where Cyril Moodie had slept, then chose a different corner.

Oskar Moodie fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Clement Dick, grazed. A letter came for Oskar Moodie with a ribbon tied around it. Oskar Moodie kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
Oskar fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Viktor Tetanusmaxxe was grazed. Oskar ate breakfast without a word.
pushkarskiivlad: The new runner gave his name as Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A parcel from home held a comb. Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into T-F9. Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv has learned to walk bent double.
Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
A man asked Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv to describe Rosenau without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
A local carter understood Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv's request for bread, then explained that the same sentence sounded very much like a request for a beard.
Listening post, three in the morning. Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards.
A round went through Karel "Saint" Pushkarskiiv's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Isidor "Spark" Hogggogins of the Hegemony (@hogggogins).
Karel returned to T-F9 limping a little. The squad pretended not to notice, and gave him the dry spot.
saigearmstro: Nobody saw Arno Saigearmstro arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in V-F5, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Edmund "Hollow" Wolf and Arno Saigearmstro spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
Arno Saigearmstro cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Arno Saigearmstro stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of V-F5, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
Arno Saigearmstro spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Arno Saigearmstro only heard boots on the duckboards at V-F5, then nothing but pain. Raider: Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak of the Hegemony (@philnowak).
Arno Saigearmstro wore a fresh bandage at V-F5 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour.
The medic cut the last bandage off Arno's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to V-F5 the same hour.
